placements.title: Continuous verification and drill routines that ensure recovery mechanisms function under operational failure
placements.frame: What verification practices, cadences, and ownership structures ensure technical recovery mechanisms remain reliable?

placements.title: Recovery mechanisms do not exist without continuous rehearsed verification
placements.frame: How does recurring rehearsal transform rollback mechanisms from theoretical assumptions into verified operational readiness?
placements.why: Quinton mandates recurring monthly Atlas rehearsals on the core axiom that unpracticed recovery capability is merely theoretical, formalized by explicit ownership and scheduling.
